research_question: Does direct autocorrelation-sequence supervision preserve SawFM period ordering under component separation better than waveform-only or learned-period supervision?
identity_policy: training roles are disjoint; OOD selection identities are disjoint from training and all confirmation identities

variants.A1_acf_0p10: waveform loss + 0.10 normalized complex autocorrelation sequence loss
variants.A2_acf_0p50: waveform loss + 0.50 normalized complex autocorrelation sequence loss

acf_contract.loss: SmoothL1 between separated and exact-component autocorrelation sequences

selection_rule: Among passing A1/A2 variants, maximize the minimum per-regime separated Pearson improvement over A0, then mean improvement, then lower mean MAE.
stop_rule: If neither A1 nor A2 passes, stop separator-loss tuning on these identities and retain the P2o failure boundary.
